scope: v3.1 pilot: doors, doorway_decals, airlock (V3_1_DESIGN 3, 5.1). Blender renders only: art/interiors/door31_*, habitat_m_doorways*, airlock_*

what_works: No longer half done: full-height opaque leaves with a window strip and a seal line, closed / half / open all read as a real sliding door (door31_*_inside.png).
Open leaves stay inside the pocket housing; nothing is hidden. The cutaway caps are solid (door31_closed/half/open.png).
The corridor collar meets the housing face; no gap seen.

fixes.fix: The housing is a 3.4 m wide, 2.56 m tall flat slab. From inside it reads as a wardrobe wall across the round room (door31_*_inside.png); from outside, roof on, it is a flat plate stuck on the dome with a dark cap (door31_*_roof.png, habitat_m_doorways_roof.png). Curve the housing's room face to the wall radius, chamfer its outer corners 8 cm, and on the outside let the dome skin run over the housing top (or give the housing a curved hood that follows the dome) so it reads as part of the room, not an add-on.

Status light: a pale mint bar reads as a lamp, not a status light. Make it a strip with a clear green emissive (#5EE07A, strength 3) and give RENDER the amber/red states on the same material (V3_1 3.1).
Leaves: add a 3 cm darker kick plate at the bottom and a hazard chevron strip at the meeting edge so closed doors read at game distance (now two grey slabs with two dark slots).
Provisional until the in-game check: door opens within 1.6 m, closes 0.8 s after, 0.6 s ease, no z-fighting at the collar.

what_works: habitat M with 2 doorways: the room band, the L-level band and the portholes stop before each door housing; no decal on an opening, roof on or cutaway (habitat_m_doorways*.png).
Airlock: the yellow band stops at the chamber block; the corridor stripe stops at the housing.

fixes.fix: Where a band stops, it stops as a raw cut. End each band 5 cm short of the housing with a small end cap (Frame colour) so the stop looks designed.

The acceptance test is in game on every room type (zero decal pixels in any opening, 0.4 m margin). Only habitat M and the airlock were split; the other rooms are not rebuilt yet. Re-rate when all rooms are done.

what_works: Reads as suit room -> chamber -> porch from above: suit racks and lockers round the dome, a central grated chamber with hazard stripes, vents and gauge panel, inner and outer door kits, a porch with a dust mat and floodlight (airlock_closed/half/open.png, airlock_anchors.png).
Exterior reads as an airlock at game distance: bulky chamber block on the dome, hazard stripes round the outer door, pumps on the roof, beacon (airlock_exterior.png, airlock_*_roof.png).
Consistent with the v3 rooms: same wall kit, accent bands, floor and door kit.

fixes.fix: Cutaway: the chamber walls and both door housings stand at full height (~2.5 m) while the outer wall is cut at 1.40 m (airlock_closed.png). From the game camera they hide the suit room and half the chamber. Cut the chamber walls to 1.40 m with solid caps like every room wall (V3_1 3.2), and keep only the door headers' caps.

Chamber 1.6 m long for 2 people (maker's point, confirmed: the grated floor is about square). Lengthen it to 2.4 m (two bodies 0.8 m apart plus door clearance), taking the space from the porch side of the dome.

Beacon: a white ball. Make it an amber rotating-beacon housing (#FFB547 lens) that RENDER can drive amber/red/green with the cycle phase; add a 3-light pressure indicator above the inner door visible from the suit room.

The dome meets the chamber block with a step at the sides (maker's point, confirmed in airlock_exterior.png). Add a curved fairing from the dome skin to the block side, or wrap the block's side walls round to the dome radius.
The porch mat's black bars read as stairs going down into the ground. Make it a flat grate with a ramp edge (hazard stripe on the lip) and 2 short bollards so it reads as a ramp onto sand.
The porch is outside the footprint: the build tool must keep a 2.5 m clear zone in front of the outer door (show it in the placement ghost) and outside paths must not cross it.
Only one size: V3_1 5.1 says every airlock size. If content keeps one size, record that decision in the contract; otherwise build S/M/L with airlock_slots anchors each.

notes: All three pass as provisional pilots; none reaches 0.80. The in-game round decides (door motion, decals on every room type, the cycle with phases and riders).
Paul's points answered: doors are no longer half done; no decal on an opening was found in the renders; the airlock now has a middle chamber with a clear suit room and porch.
